claim: You can automatically increase an FSx for Windows File Server file system's storage capacity when free storage capacity falls below a threshold that you specify, by deploying the AWS-developed custom CloudFormation template that implements the automated solution.

values.display: automatically increase your file system's storage capacity

evidence.quote: You can automatically increase your file system's storage capacity when the amount of free storage capacity falls below a defined threshold that you specify.
Use the AWS‐developed custom CloudFormation template to deploy all of the components required to implement the automated solution.
